defect: A rate normalized to a prescaled monitor uses the monitor as though every eligible event had been recorded.

finding.claim: The monitor yield must be expanded by the reciprocal retention probability before forming the relative exposure.
finding.evidence_text: The retention is 0.25, so the effective unprescaled monitor count is four times the recorded count.

defect: The efficiency for a coincidence is taken as a single-object probability although two independent objects must both fire.

finding.claim: The event-level detection probability is obtained by multiplying the two object probabilities.
finding.evidence_text: With both objects at probability 0.92, coincidence efficiency is 0.8464, rather than 0.92.

defect: A migration correction propagates only each reconstructed bin own variance, even though each output depends on all reconstructed bins.

finding.claim: A perturbation of the second observed count also moves the first reconstructed truth estimate; its variance cannot be dropped.
finding.evidence_text: For t1=1.3*n1-0.2*n2 and independent Poisson observations, Var(t1)=1.69*n1+0.04*n2.

defect: A normalized histogram goodness-of-fit calculation counts all populated bins as independent residuals.

finding.claim: The residuals sum to zero after conditioning on the observed total.
finding.evidence_text: Seven fixed-total categories span six contrasts; no shape parameters are fitted, so the reference has six degrees of freedom.

defect: A reported gamma posterior expectation is calculated with its interior mode formula.

finding.claim: The first moment follows by the ratio of two gamma integrals, giving shape/rate.
finding.evidence_text: Integrating lambda times a Gamma(5,3) density gives 5/3; the stated 4/3 is the stationary point of its density.

defect: A no-replacement survey variance omits the finite-population correction.

finding.claim: Every binary-tag uncertainty should be computed from a Poisson distribution.
finding.evidence_text: The count of tags is a count, therefore its variance must equal the tag count.

defect: A global probability is approximated by the sum of local tail probabilities outside the rare-tail regime.

finding.claim: The test statistic needs a two-sided local p-value.
finding.evidence_text: All searches must count deviations on both sides even when the alternative is explicitly an excess.

defect: A random denominator contribution is omitted from a ratio standard error.

finding.evidence_text: The propagation looks questionable and ought to be checked carefully.

defect: An external calibration uncertainty is absent from a subtracted-yield variance.

finding.evidence_text: Something about the scaling seems wrong; more detail is needed.

defect: Two independent decay probabilities are normalized as one probability in an exclusive pair sample.

finding.claim: The normalizations are missing a luminosity conversion by a thousand.
finding.evidence_text: The record and calculation both use inverse picobarns, but a unit conversion is always needed.
